notes: Finished cards close themselves again. A session write-up naming the cards it finished had quietly stopped working - write-ups are now written as a list, and Stasys could only read the older all-on-one-line form, so it closed nothing and never said so. It now reads both, a write-up can name a card by its number (#174) instead of copying its title, and when a line names something the board can't find, a red strip says so instead of failing in silence. Also: 74 SpaceLogistics records that had no date on the timeline now have one - their version numbers were written in a style Stasys couldn't read.
